architecture.subtitle: Neural Trust Framework -- runtime demonstration artifact (not a research contribution, CLAUDE.md §16a)
architecture.kernel_terminology_note: "Runtime Trust Orchestrator" and "Trust Kernel" name the same component (CLAUDE.md §2).
architecture.position_a: Locked: all evidence including FSI is software-forgeable in V1. T5 rests entirely on enforcement-plane termination.

ceil._comment: REFERENCE VALUES (CLAUDE.md §6). Ceil is a deployment-time prescription bound -- the authority a clinician grants this user on this device, provisioned out-of-band at commissioning, computed as the infimum of (U_ISO ∩ U_Robot ∩ U_App) over the operating region. Not a clinical prescription, not a measured quantity, not derived from any runtime observation. The commissioning-time derivation process itself is out of scope for the enforcer -- the enforcer holds this constant only, loaded once at process start, and never receives, derives, or recomputes it from any verdict or evidence.

env._comment: REFERENCE VALUES (CLAUDE.md §6). Φ = (max_speed, max_acceleration), mm/s and mm/s², fixed-point ints, no floats. Φ is permissive dimensions only (P8) -- Env(Safe) = (0,0) reads 'command no motion at no acceleration': Safe is a controlled stop by construction, not an absence of command.

eeg_sample.note: REAL recorded trial, replayed for display -- this project is software-only offline (CLAUDE.md §1), there is no live acquisition to show.

Signal.provenance_note: raw_measurement computed directly from the real Phase-7 filtered EEG trace (SNR / band-power / line-noise) on the same host process as the pipeline that produced it -- no protocol emulation involved. Runs on the host, so A_code (arbitrary code execution at host privilege, §3) can rewrite it; this is honest-evidence-conditional, per T4/T5's honest partition.

Model.provenance_note: Real Ed25519 signature and hash verification over the on-path Phase-7 classifier artifact (the actual model object used for inference this session, not a stand-in) -- the cryptography is real, but it runs on the same host as the model it is checking, so it is EMULATED_PROTOCOL rather than REAL: it is a protocol demonstration, not an independent hardware root of trust.

Calibration.provenance_note: raw_measurement computed directly from real session-E feature-distribution drift against the session-T enrollment distribution (BCIC IV 2a's own cross-session structure, §17a) on the same host process -- no protocol emulation involved.

Device.provenance_note: Real DTLS handshake result plus sequence/replay-counter check via OpenSSL/mbedTLS, OFF-path: the EEG data path does not traverse this DTLS channel, only the emulated device-link protocol under test does. A real protocol run, but not the path the trust decision is actually about.

FSI.provenance_note: Real swtpm PCR-extend/quote/AIK verification, ON-path in the sense that it gates this window's evidence, but boot-time only -- it attests firmware/software state as measured at boot, not ongoing runtime execution, so it provides no protection against A_code acting after boot (§3 Position A).

ActuationFidelity.provenance_note: Commanded-vs-observed discrepancy measured by the Phase-6 Observer against a simulated actuator, running as an independent subsystem process, never inside the enforcer (P2, structurally checked by Phase 6's static+dynamic scan). Independent of the enforcer process does not mean independent of the host: A_code at host privilege can still reach this process, so forgeable_under_A_code is TRUE like every other V1 row.

honest_control_row.description: Control row: the best-case honest computation from maximally-healthy-looking evidence, run through the real pi. Post-relattice (L^6) the honest path legitimately reaches Normal under the current provisional EIS config -- included to show what the honest path actually produces, NOT to pad the violation count.

fsi_inclusion_correction.open_question_for_the_PI: FSI's own claim_registry.json provenance_note describes it as attesting firmware/software state 'as measured at boot... boot-time only' -- this may mean a real deployment does NOT need a fresh TPM quote every 100ms window (unlike Signal/Calibration/Model/Device, which are genuinely per-window measurements), in which case this violation is an artifact of this driver's uniform per-window measurement convention applied to a claim whose real cadence may be coarser, not a genuine architectural problem. This driver does not resolve that question -- it measures FSI's ACTUAL cost if invoked every window (which is what a fresh TPM quote genuinely costs, ~60-83ms, measured not assumed) and reports the consequence honestly rather than assuming the coarser cadence without evidence for it.
fsi_inclusion_correction.reason: budget_verification above sums only 4 of 5 real-time producers (Signal/Calibration/Model/Device), excluding FSI because it was measured in a separate loop (real swtpm quotes, smaller N) -- documented in budget_verification.fsi_kernel_decision_note, but that note reported FSI's p99 alongside the result without folding it into the VIOLATED verdict, which effectively hid a real violation behind the exclusion. Corrected here post-hoc from the already-recorded per-stage data (no rerun needed): if FSI's evidence_generation_fsi/statement_signing_fsi ARE required every 100ms window (fresh TPM quote per window, as this driver's per-window convention assumed for every other producer), both budgets ARE violated at p99.

budget_verification.fsi_kernel_decision_note: FSI's own evidence_generation_fsi/statement_signing_fsi (measured separately, N=30) are NOT included in the sums above (they were measured in a separate loop from the other 4 producers) -- reported alongside, in fsi_stats, for a complete picture; a real single window's decision path would additionally include FSI's real p99 evidence_generation_fsi=83.421ms + statement_signing_fsi=0.327ms.

hung_producer_demonstration.note: hung_signal() sleeps 2.0s (2000ms) before it would even compute a value -- far longer than Delta(w)=60ms. collect_within_deadline() never waits for it: the hung thread is simply abandoned (daemon=True) once the shared 60ms budget elapses, and admission/kernel/policy proceed on whatever arrived. The invariant under test is collection_latency_bounded_by_deadline_not_hang_duration -- collection wall time is ~60ms, not ~2000ms, regardless of the hung producer's real behaviour.

detection.mechanism: T4 admission window_id-matches-round check (statement) + enforcement AcceptCache 2-entry ring (verdict)

statement_replay.note: A replayed statement is REJECTED at admission, never substituted as if fresh -- the dimension then reads LOW via absence (CLAUDE.md 10), not via a stale value entering the lattice.

reasoning_correctness.note: raw_measurement dropped from -14 to -25 (real, measured) but the level stayed HIGH because theta1=-100 sits at signal_sensor.RAW_FLOOR (-100) itself under the measured config's active (tightest-swept-budget) alpha -- Signal is tail_floor-resolved (docs/PHASE9-MEASURED-ROC.md): its ROC jumps from FPR=0 at threshold=-100 directly past the sub-ppb alpha budget at the very next integer threshold, so the Tail-Floor Rule's conservative floor pins theta1 at the absolute measurement floor. LOW is then reachable only by a raw_measurement AT that exact floor -- a correctly-conservative consequence of pricing spurious halts near zero (CLAUDE.md 4: 'alpha prices spurious halts'), not a driver bug or a weak detector: it means only an injection severe enough to saturate the SNR/line-noise composite score at its floor would register as LOW here, and this run's injection did not reach that. [Classified per PI review as Case (a): moved toward LOW but fell short of theta1 -- Tail-Floor-Rule conservatism, contrast with adversarial_eeg Case (b).]

results.note: Signal is the only V1 dimension that reads raw EEG; whether an adversarial perturbation crafted to flip the classifier also perturbs Signal's spectral measurement enough to be caught is an empirical question this driver actually measures, per-run, rather than assuming. See reasoning_correctness.note for the case (a)/(b) classification.

reasoning_correctness.note: Case (b) -- a genuine detector blind spot, NOT a threshold artifact: raw_measurement did not move toward LOW at all -- it moved AWAY from LOW, from -14 to -3 (more trustworthy-looking after the attack than before), independent of where theta1 sits. Mechanistic reason: this perturbation is a sinusoid at 18 Hz, inside the mu/beta band (8-30 Hz) SignalSensor treats as the wanted signal (sensors/signal_sensor.py: snr_ratio = mu_beta_power / broadband_power). Energy concentrated IN that band raises the SNR numerator regardless of whether the energy is genuine motor-imagery signal or injected adversarial energy -- the measurement cannot distinguish the two by construction. This is a real, reportable blind spot for in-band-concentrated adversarial perturbations specifically, distinct from attack_signal_injection Case (a) (broadband noise, which DOES move the score the correct direction) -- not folded into the Tail-Floor Rule explanation, because no threshold placement would fix a score that moves the wrong way.

detection.mechanism: ModelSensor real SHA-256 artifact-hash mismatch against the pinned signing_record

reasoning_correctness.note: replacement model trained on real subject 2 session data (genuinely different weights, still a real fitted classifier -- not a bit-flip or random bytes), substituted for subject 1's pinned artifact without a matching signing record.

results.note: No-detector class by design (CLAUDE.md 3, model_sensor.py's own docstring): training-pipeline poisoning precedes signing. This is reported as uncovered-but-consequence-bounded, not a gap to fill by adding a detector -- ModelSensor verifies artifact integrity, never training provenance.

reasoning_correctness.note: Model's evidence reads CEIL because the poisoned artifact IS honestly signed and IS the artifact actually running -- integrity, not provenance, is what this claim measures. The real consequence is the measured accuracy drop above, invisible to the evidence layer.

FSI is a CTPR parent (FSI->Signal, FSI->Model): via CTPR, this floors Signal's and Model's EFFECTIVE level even though their own raw measurements are untouched -- see controlled_six_dim_verdict's effective_dims.

T4 admission arrival-before-Delta(w) check + enforcement now<expires_at check

reasoning_correctness.note: A late statement is never waited for and never substituted -- rejected outright, the dimension then reads LOW via absence (CLAUDE.md §7's deadline invariant, empirically demonstrated separately and more thoroughly in docs/PHASE10-LATENCY-EVALUATION.md §7).

AF for window w can only be observed AFTER window w's own enforcement action -- this is reactive, one window in arrears, and is documented as such rather than claimed to gate the very actuation that produced it (see experiments/phase8_evidence_producers.py's same, already-documented asymmetry).

results.note: No-detector class by design (CLAUDE.md 3; experiments/phase5_enforcement.py's 'actuator_manipulation_in_envelope_wrong_command' class). T5 bounds MAGNITUDE (realise <= Ceil componentwise); it says nothing about direction/target, and this driver does not claim otherwise. Reported plainly as a residual limitation, not worked around.

reasoning_correctness.note: Phi's only fields are max_speed and max_acceleration (CLAUDE.md §6) -- magnitude bounds. A command at the SAME magnitude but the WRONG direction/target passes every check in this codebase unchanged, because no field to check against exists. This is a structural fact about the wire/config schema, not a policy gap that could be closed by tuning a threshold.

coverage_matrix.detection_mechanism: T4 admission window_id-matches-round check (statement) + enforcement AcceptCache 2-entry ring (verdict)
coverage_matrix.residual: Bounded to the tested replay window/cache size; a stale statement outside the tested horizon is not separately exercised here.

Detection depends on the measured Signal threshold at the swept budget in force; Signal is tail-floored (docs/PHASE9-MEASURED-ROC.md) -- a subtler injection near the conservative floor is not separately swept here.

This run's in-band-concentrated perturbation is a genuine detector BLIND SPOT (case b: raw_measurement moved away from LOW, not merely short of threshold) -- SignalSensor's SNR measure cannot distinguish genuine mu/beta-band signal from adversarial energy placed in the same band. Broadband perturbations (attack_signal_injection) do not share this blind spot. Not a general guarantee against all adversarial crafting either way.

coverage_matrix.detection_mechanism: ModelSensor real SHA-256 artifact-hash mismatch against the pinned signing_record
coverage_matrix.residual: Bounded to substitution without the artifact-publisher's private key; a compromised publisher key is out of scope for this producer (P2/Position A: forgeable_under_A_code TRUE).
No-detector by design: training-pipeline poisoning precedes signing and is invisible to artifact-integrity verification.
Bounded to boot-time PCR state; an attacker who achieves code execution AFTER boot (A_code) is invisible to FSI by construction (docs/THREAT-MODEL.md §4).

coverage_matrix.detection_mechanism: Real OpenSSL DTLS chain verification (device link) + Ed25519 signature verification over the exact signed bytes (any claim type)
coverage_matrix.residual: Bounded to tamper detectable via signature/handshake failure; a compromised sensor signing key (A_data) produces validly-signed forged evidence undetectably.

coverage_matrix.detection_mechanism: T4 admission arrival-before-Delta(w) check + enforcement now<expires_at check
coverage_matrix.residual: Bounded to the fixed 100ms window/Delta(w)/expiry parameters; does not itself bound clock-source integrity, which Position A assigns to A_data (host clocks are A_data-owned).
Reactive by one window (documented asymmetry); cannot gate the very actuation that produced the discrepancy it measures.
No-detector by design: bounded in magnitude only (T5/Phi); direction/target has no bounding mechanism anywhere in this codebase.

attacks.position_a_scope_note: Under CLAUDE.md 3 Position A, every statement here is software-forgeable by A_data/A_code, like all V1 evidence. Rows (i)/(ii) above demonstrate honest-evidence reasoning correctness and real protocol-level detection; only row (iii), consequence-boundedness (T5), is unconditional against A_data. No row here establishes an adversarial bound on evidence integrity itself.

faults.mode_verified: no fresh verdict past expires_at is ever accepted -- enforcer produces no envelope
faults.scope_caveat: Verified: the enforcer never acts on a stale verdict. NOT verified (out of scope for software alone, CLAUDE.md §6): that the physical actuator reaches Safe on its own once no envelope is being refreshed -- that is the watchdog/hardware-liveness mechanism's job, not yet built in V1. This driver does not claim otherwise.

faults.mode_verified: no process other than the one holding the exact original capability object can write
faults.scope_caveat: Verified: no write succeeds without the exact live capability token. NOT verified (same caveat as kernel_termination): that the physical actuator reaches Safe on its own with no enforcer alive to write anything at all -- watchdog/hardware territory, CLAUDE.md §6, not yet built.

faults.mode_verified: a suppressed producer's dimension reads LOW via absence, never a default/substitute value
faults.note: Suppressing FSI (a CTPR parent, edges FSI->Signal/FSI->Model) drags Signal's and Model's EFFECTIVE level to LOW via meet(child, g(FSI))=meet(child, LOW)=LOW even though their own raw measurements are untouched -- the same propagation mechanism Phase 11's firmware_modification attack demonstrated, here triggered by absence rather than a failed integrity check.

faults.mode_verified: accept(nu) requires now < expires_at strictly -- an expired verdict never produces an envelope
a tampered entry is detected, and it plus every subsequent entry is reported broken
faults.observed_variant: A raw arbitrary-offset byte flip (tried during development) instead corrupted the CBOR framing itself, causing read_all() to raise CanonError before verify_chain() ran -- also fail-loud, a coarser/earlier failure than the hash-chain check this function isolates. Both are real, observed failure modes; neither is fail-silent.

Source (experiments/phase10_latency_evaluation.py's check_budgets) fixed for future runs to make the FSI-inclusive check a first-class result, not a buried note.

PI review requested distinguishing WHY adversarial_eeg was not detected: (a) moved toward LOW but fell short of theta1 (Tail-Floor-Rule conservatism) vs (b) did not move toward LOW at all (a genuine detector blind spot). Classified using the already-recorded honest_signal_raw=-14 / attacked_signal_raw=-3 values (attacked_raw > honest_raw -- moved AWAY from LOW) as Case (b), with a mechanistic explanation (in-band 18Hz perturbation raises SignalSensor's SNR numerator regardless of energy source). No new injection, no re-run of the real pipeline, no threshold or measured value changed -- report annotation only, source driver also updated so future runs compute this classification automatically.

limitations: Version-control freeze is not an external pre-registration -- docs/OSF-PREREGISTRATION.md (draft, not submitted) is what would be.
Signal and Calibration are tail-floored at ALL three swept budgets (0.1%, 1%, 5%) -- not point estimates.
ActuationFidelity has no offline measurement path -- calibration_status cannot be flipped to measured for it.
FSI and Device are ungrounded on this hardware class: EMULATED_PROTOCOL, FSI is boot-time-only, Device is off-path.
Offline-evaluation boundary: emulated-protocol claims (Model/Device/FSI) resolve cleanly; measured-EEG claims (Signal/Calibration) cannot be sharply calibrated on trial-structured offline data.

FSI's real per-window attestation cost (~60-83ms) exceeds Delta(w)=60ms and the 67ms decision-path budget when included -- resolved as a performance/deployability question, not a security one (docs/PHASE10-LATENCY-EVALUATION.md §4, docs/THREAT-MODEL.md §4).
Software-only: no hardware root of trust in V1, no clinical population, no live BCI hardware (CLAUDE.md §1).
